# Packages for the Hyprland desktop stack on Fedora (dnf).
# One package per line. Comments with #. Blank lines are ignored.
# Consume with: grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' deps/packages.dnf.txt | xargs sudo dnf install -y

# Notes for tools not in standard Fedora official repos:
# - quickshell: Build from source (https://github.com/quickshell-mirror/quickshell) or check COPR.
# - cliphist, swww, mpvpaper, hyprpicker, hyprshot:
#   Available via COPR repositories (e.g. solopasha/hyprland) or cargo / release binaries.
